stemMd: A cell has abundant smooth endoplasmic reticulum. Which activity is particularly associated with this organelle?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Translation on ribosomes attached to its surface

options.label: B
options.textMd: Digestion of extracellular food in a stomach

options.label: E
options.textMd: Storage of chromosomes inside a spindle

explanationMd: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum lacks attached ribosomes and contributes to lipid synthesis, detoxification and calcium handling in appropriate cells. Protein synthesis by attached ribosomes is associated with rough endoplasmic reticulum. The distinction is functional as well as visual.

distractorRationale.d: This is associated with the nucleolus.
distractorRationale.e: Chromosomes are not stored inside a spindle.
distractorRationale.a: Attached ribosomes distinguish rough rather than smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
distractorRationale.b: The stomach is an organ, not an intracellular endoplasmic-reticulum activity.
